raw_response:
1. There is no explicit 30 GB benchmark line shown in the figure. Relative to 30 GB, Full FT (~70+ GB) and MTL-FT (~40 GB) are above it, while TAG/LoRA/Ours (~20–22 GB) and QLoRA (~12–13 GB) are below it.  
2. The figure shows “Ours” at roughly ~21–22 GB, not ~30 GB. Compared to QLoRA (~12–13 GB), “Ours” uses about ~8–10 GB more GPU memory (roughly ~1.6–1.8× higher).  
3. Statistical significance is not provided in the figure (no error bars, sample sizes, or p-values). You can only say MTL-FT uses more memory than TAG (about ~40 GB vs ~21–22 GB), not whether that difference is statistically significant.
